motions.label: Programmed side get-up → learned balance
motions.description: Starts right and folds the lower leg, then selects the get-up from measured orientation. This example passes both timesteps. 35/45 fresh perturbed starts across 9 fall directions pass both timesteps with this recipe.
motions.limit_text: 73/90 rollouts pass in that bank. The full 24-second recording includes motor-held settling, one side transfer and programmed recovery followed by learned balance. Four motors and 120 mm wheels are unchanged. This is experimental: reliable all-fall recovery, impacts, varied initial leg poses, estimator errors, self-contact dynamics and hardware qualification remain unproven.
